newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gucci reports record profits, sales.
newsitem.headline: Gucci reports record profits, sales.

text.p: Gucci Group N.V., the luxury goods maker, said Thursday its earnings soared 165 percent to a record in the first six months of the year.
The company said it had net profits of $69.9 million, or $1.15 a share, in the first half compared with year ago earnings of $26.4 million, or 58 cents a share.
Gucci said its sales jumped 89 percent to a record $390 million from $206.2 million in the first six months of 1995.
Following the news, Gucci's stock was up 87.5 cents at $77 on the New York Stock Exchange.
"Gucci designs continue to receive critical acclaim in the fashion press worldwide," said Domenico De Sole, president and chief executive officer.

"Strong sell-through of all of our product categories at the store level and a continuing focus on controlling our overall cost structure resulted in exceptional operating margins for the first half of 1996," he said.
